_comment: Dungeons whose boss room leaves the winners in a room of its own before the way out: a room
with no fight, where an NPC offers to leave. Winning the boss room loads that room on its
cell instead of the catalogue's exit, and leaving goes out through the dungeon's own exit
(DungeonManager.WayOut) -- from the NPC's exit replies or the map panel's «Salir de la
bossRoom  the room whose win leads here
room      the post-boss room, not one of the dungeon's fight rooms
cell      where the winners stand in it
npc       the NPC that offers the way out there
replies   his replies that leave; his others keep their own behaviour

exits.why: The Sylvan Refuge: after Raccooper the winners are in his refuge's last room (224137218), where he gives up the fight («This fight ends here. I won't risk standing up to you any longer.») and «Leave the Sylvan Refuge.» leaves, as does the quest's «...and leave the Sylvan Refuge.». The room had no border, no interactive and no NPC who leads out. INFERRED cells.

Kickroach's Lair: after the boss the winners are in «Kickroach's Lair - Exit» (146538496), where Kickroach (2767) stands with the Magic Croquette (2771, giver of «Miniature Adventure», 1607, whose first objective is to talk to him there). The win went straight to Kerub's Attic and he was never met. His four «Leave Kickroach's Lair.» replies leave. INFERRED cell: open floor in front of him.

Kharnotaurus's Lair: after Kharnotaurus the winners are in «Kharnotaurus's Lair - Exit» (199495682), where the innkeeper of the door, Lee O'Summerly, takes them out («By my godfathers! What a mess you've made inside!», then «Leave Kharnotaurus's Lair.»). The room had no border, no interactive and no NPC. INFERRED cells.

The Moumousetrap: after the Black Rat the winners are in her last room, where she lets them out (her replies already lead to the entrance) and the militiawoman of «Fait comme un rat» stays with her. INFERRED cell: by the Black Rat (356).
The White Rat's Pantry: after the White Rat the winners are in her last room, where she lets them out («Salir de la mazmorra») and D'Arratagnan waits for them. INFERRED cell: between the two.

The goblins' Akademia: after director Grunob the winners are in his office, where «De joyeux petits arbres» has them ask for Gob Ross's brush («Une fois le donjon terminé, parlez au Directeur Grunob», Dofus pour les noobs); «Abandonar la Akademia» leaves.

Moon's tree: after Moon the winners are at the top of his tree, where «Rendez-vous avec la lune» has them offer him the moon root («Une fois le combat terminé, offrez la racine lunaire de gisengoku au Moon», Dofus pour les noobs); «Abandonar el Árbol de Moon» leaves.

Le Chuko's ship: after Le Chuko the winners are in his cabin, where «Squelettes et amulettes» has them order him to give the amulet back («Avant de sortir du donjon, parlez au Chouque», Dofus pour les noobs); «Abandonar el navío de Le Chuko» leaves.

Kardorim's crypt (PR #75, 23 October 2026): the win in his room loads the post-boss room on cell 382; his four template replies «Quitter la crypte de Kardorim» (texts 555709-555712) leave; his quest and Milimilou replies do not.

The Haunted Mansion: after Boostache the winners are in the mansion's last room [-13,-41], which «Fantômes contre fantômes» asks to discover (4149), and the chafer host takes them out («reparlez au Gentil Organisateur Chafer pour sortir du donjon», Dofus pour les noobs); his two «Salir» replies leave.

The Kwakwa's nest: after the Kwakwa the winners are in the nest's exit room [-4,-7] («The Kwakwa's Nest - Exit»), which «L'Ascension» asks to discover (4329), and the Kwakerback host takes them out; his «Salir» leaves.

The Kanniboul village: after Kanniboul Ebil the winners are in the village's exit room [29,9] («Kanniball Village - Exit»), which «T'as les boules» asks to discover (4113), and the kanniboul host takes them out («reparlez au Gentil Organisateur pour sortir du donjon», Dofus pour les noobs); his two «Salir» replies leave.

The Lair of the Rac Queen: after Lasoberaña's fight the winners are in the lair's exit room [-6,-15], where «Arak-haï en pagaille» has her talk (9558); her «Abandonar la guarida de Lasoberaña» replies leave.

The Ancestral Domain: after the Ancestral Treechnid the winners are in the domain's exit room [-9,-14], where «Munster lève le mystère» questions him (9567), and Tronky Tranky takes them out; his «Salir del Territorio Ancestral» leaves.

The Soft Oak Clearing: after the Soft Oak the winners are in the clearing's exit room [-14,-13], where «L'art de la langue de bois» questions him (9581), and Josefa Taplana takes them out; her «Salir del claro» leaves.

The Grotto Hesque: after the Coralator Master the winners are in «Grotto Hesque - Exit» (5244422), where Tina Montini, the keeper, waits for them: her template's second line (4191) is «El pobre Coralador Magistral no habrá durado mucho... Te enseñaré la salida.» and «Salir de la Gruta Grut'Hesqua.» (3669) leaves. The win went straight to the entrance and the room was never seen. INFERRED cell: open floor two rows below her (373).

The hidden laboratory's Exit room: «Vous voilà maintenant devant Jean Nauh» (Dofus pour les noobs) after the four fights; «Salir.» leaves (his «Aceptar y salir del laboratorio.» leaves through his tree, once it has done 969).

The last map of the Floribund Clearing, where Juana Morros hides: «Une fois tous ces monstres tués vous trouvez sa femme» (Dofus pour les noobs); her «Acepto.» leaves through her tree, back to the doctor on the branches.

Brumen Tinctorias's laboratory: after Nelwynn (the fifth room) the winners are in the laboratory's own way out («LaboRATory - Exit», 176952320), where Tassa offers «Salir del laboratorio»; reaching it is «¿Dónde se ha ido la 7.ª compañía?»'s 4555. Cell 330: open floor in front of the workbench, two cells from Tassa.

Thor Pestruz's aviary: after the fifth room the winners are in the aviary's own way out («Cross Strich's Aviary - Exit», 132912128), where Orno Tóligo shows the stairs down. Cell 328: open floor of the pen, two cells from him.

Dramak's Theatre: after the Puppet Master (Auditorium 5) the winners are in the theatre's Exit room where Dramak stands, and «Ainsi font les petites marionnettes» has them talk to him before leaving («Une fois le donjon terminé, parlez à Dramak mais ne sortez pas tout de suite», Dofus pour les noobs); «Abandonar el Teatro de Dramak.» and «Abandonar el teatro con la sensación de haber cumplido con tu deber.» leave. INFERRED cell: two rows above Dramak's (399), on the stage's floor.

Sombra's Pyramid: after Sombra (Fifth Room) the winners are in the pyramid's Exit room where he stands beaten, and «L'armée des ombres» has them chain him there before leaving («Une fois que vous avez vaincu Ombre parlez lui et attachez le avec les chaînes au sol de la Pyramide», Dofus pour les noobs); his three «Salir de la Pirámide de Sombra.» leave. INFERRED cell: two rows below his (314).

Merkator's Aquadome: after the Treasure Room the winners are in the Aquadome's Exit room where Merkator stands, and «Pollution, je dis non» (Dofus pour les noobs) has them talk to him there; «Salir del Acuadomo de Merkator.», «Encogerte de hombros y salir del Acuadomo.» and «Darle algunas réplicas sinceras e irte.» leave. INFERRED cell: open floor a row below Merkator's.

The Wa Wabbit's castle: after the Wa Wabbit the winners are in the castle's Exit room («Castillo del Wey Wabbit - Salida»), where he sits beaten by his throne, and «Le château du Wa» has them talk to him there («Une fois le Wa Wabbit vaincu, parlez lui», Dofus pour les noobs); his two «Salir.» leave. Cell 326: the room's way in, across the carpet from him.

The Wa Wabbit's burrow: after the Wa Wobot the winners are in the burrow's Exit room («Madriguera del Wey Wabbit - Salida»), where the guardian of the carrot dofus stands by its pedestal, and «L'œuf ou la cawotte ?» has them talk to him there («Il vous faut finir le Terrier du Wa Wabbit pour parler au Gawdien du Dofus», Dofus pour les noobs). «Apoderarte del dofus zanahowia y escaparte.» and «Irte sin buscar problemas.» leave by the dungeon's own exit. Cell 282: the room's way in.

Lord Crow's library: after the master the winners are in the antechamber next to his throne room, where Natacha waits for his guide in «Voler dans les plumes» («Avant de sortir, parlez à Natacha Manka qui vous demandera le guide», Dofus pour les noobs; 11395's map) and Virgil's «Salir de la biblioteca» leaves. INFERRED cell, an open walkable one.

Kanígrula's cave: after the matriarch the winners are in the cave's exit room, where she stands beaten and «La risueña miaumiena» has them ask her for Pol («Une fois Kanigroula mise au tapis, celle-ci mécontente vous menace», Dofus pour les noobs, «Chachyène de vie»); her three «Salir de la Gruta de Kanígrula» leave. INFERRED cell, an open walkable one in front of her.

The Minotoror's labyrinth: after the Minotoror the winners are in the antechamber, where «Taures et détours» has them cast the spell at the stone throne («Rendez-vous dans l'antichambre et cliquez sur le trône de pierre», Dofus pour les noobs) and Lorkos congratulates them (3210); his «Salir» (2835) leaves. INFERRED cell, open floor before Lorkos (343).

The Blop enclave: after the fourth room the players are in Bibiblop's hall, where he lets them choose the Royal Blop («Une fois la salle 4 terminée vous pouvez choisir la couleur du Blop Royal que vous souhaitez affronter en parlant à Bibiblop», Dofus pour les noobs); the map panel leaves. INFERRED cell, open floor near Bibiblop (343).

After the Blop Coco Real, the enclave's exit room, where Bibiblop takes the key holders into the Royal Rainbow Blop's lair («Une fois le boss vaincu, vous pouvez choisir de combattre le Blop Multicolore... ou de simplement sortir en parlant de nouveau à Bibiblop», Dofus pour les noobs); the map panel leaves. INFERRED cell, open floor near Bibiblop (227).

After the Blop Índigo Real, the enclave's exit room, where Bibiblop takes the key holders into the Royal Rainbow Blop's lair («Une fois le boss vaincu, vous pouvez choisir de combattre le Blop Multicolore... ou de simplement sortir en parlant de nouveau à Bibiblop», Dofus pour les noobs); the map panel leaves. INFERRED cell, open floor near Bibiblop (227).

After the Blop Guinda Real, the enclave's exit room, where Bibiblop takes the key holders into the Royal Rainbow Blop's lair («Une fois le boss vaincu, vous pouvez choisir de combattre le Blop Multicolore... ou de simplement sortir en parlant de nouveau à Bibiblop», Dofus pour les noobs); the map panel leaves. INFERRED cell, open floor near Bibiblop (227).

After the Blop Reineta Real, the enclave's exit room, where Bibiblop takes the key holders into the Royal Rainbow Blop's lair («Une fois le boss vaincu, vous pouvez choisir de combattre le Blop Multicolore... ou de simplement sortir en parlant de nouveau à Bibiblop», Dofus pour les noobs); the map panel leaves. INFERRED cell, open floor near Bibiblop (227).

The Ring del Capitán Eskarlata: after the ring, the captain's dressing room (136579072, his statues at its door, where the client's quests find him), where «L'anneau de Tot» has you ask him a reward («ATTENTION : Ne sortez pas tout de suite à la fin du donjon», Dofus pour les noobs); «Salir del Ring del Capitán Eskarlata» leaves. INFERRED cell, on the carpet.

The Royal Mastogob's Greenhouse: after the Jalamut Real the winners are under the dome of its exit room («Royal Mastogob's Greenhouse - Exit»), where «Le pouvoir derrière le trône» has them talk to Gavroch (objective 8706 names this map), and Topordo Spesos, the host who let them in, takes them out: his three «Salir de la mazmorra» leave. No door is drawn in the room and the client shows no map panel exit there. INFERRED cell, before the round table.

The Dragon Pig's Den: after the Dragon Pig the winners are in its throne room, the den's exit (72363008, «Sala del trono del Dragocerdo», objective 9948), where «Dragones y chapuzonas» has them find the toothed key («Dans la salle de sortie, pensez à récupérer la Clef Dentée à gauche du Trône puis sortez», Dofus pour les noobs («Plongeon et dragon»)); the porco who keeps the den's doors (784) takes them out: «Me he fijado como luchabas...» (3231), «Salir.» (2864). INFERRED landing.

The post-boss room of Nawidad's dungeon 36 (66590208): Héctor Nawidad is waiting there (the client's «Termina la mazmorra de Nawidad», objective 4566 of quest 705) and «Salir» (8720) takes the winners out. INFERRED landing cell; Dofus pour les noobs «Sapik épique et Colégram» / «Petit Papa Nowel» / «Vilain petit n'enfant».

The post-boss room of Nawidad's dungeon 37 (66851840): Héctor Nawidad is waiting there (the client's «Termina la mazmorra de Nawidad», objective 4568 of quest 706) and «Salir» (8721) takes the winners out. INFERRED landing cell; Dofus pour les noobs «Sapik épique et Colégram» / «Petit Papa Nowel» / «Vilain petit n'enfant».

The post-boss room of Nawidad's dungeon 38 (66327552): Héctor Nawidad is waiting there (the client's «Termina la mazmorra de Nawidad», objective 4570 of quest 707) and «Salir» (8722) takes the winners out. INFERRED landing cell; Dofus pour les noobs «Sapik épique et Colégram» / «Petit Papa Nowel» / «Vilain petit n'enfant».

The post-boss room of the Cil's Den (dungeon 59): quest 624 «Canozzirujana» (Dofus pour les noobs, the Frigost dungeon quests) has an objective, 4257, that names this map (62920704) after the boss 2968; the client's line 8428 is the guardian's thanks and «Salir» (8451) takes the winners out. INFERRED landing cell.

The post-boss room of the Golosotes' Antechamber (dungeon 61): quest 626 «Allá arriba, en el pico helado...» (Dofus pour les noobs, the Frigost dungeon quests) has an objective, 4285, that names this map (62136840) after the boss 2864; the client line 8460 is the guardian thanks and «Salir de la Antecámara de los Golosotes» (8479) takes the winners out. INFERRED landing cell.

The post-boss room of the Royal Morsagüino's Excavation (dungeon 55): after the boss 2848 the winners stand in map 56103936 [-64,-55], which the client names in objectives 4510 and 4529, and Waldos (1300) waits there (Dofus pour les noobs «Las joyas de la corona»: «reparlez à Waldos afin de quitter le donjon»). His line 7837 is the towel before leaving; «Salir de la Excavación de Morsagüino Real» (7851) and «Salir» (7902) take the winners out. INFERRED landing cell.

The Snowfoux Den (dungeon 58): after the Fourth Room the players stand in the transition room, where Givrihaltès (1385) lets them choose Tengu Snowfoux alone or Tengu and Fuji Snowfoux (dungeons 9007 and 9008): «Une fois que vous avez terminé la salle 4, vous arrivez dans une salle de transition où vous pouvez choisir entre affronter Tengu Givrefoux seul ou Tengu et Fuji Givrefoux ensemble» (Dofus pour les noobs). The map panel leaves. INFERRED: the Throne Room as that room, and the landing cell in its middle.

After Tengu Snowfoux alone (dungeon 9007) the winners stand in map 59518976 'Exit to the Petrified Forest', which objective 4144 of «Hace fresco, pero no importa» (623) names; Dofus pour les noobs: «a la fin du combat, cliquez sur l'un des trous présents dans la salle afin de sortir». The hole (element 458461, cell 288) leaves for the forest. Landing cell 397 is the hole's own landing from the Path room.

After Tengu and Fuji Snowfoux (dungeon 9008), the same Exit to the Petrified Forest as after Tengu alone (dungeon 9007): objective 4144 of «Hace fresco, pero no importa» (623) names it, and its hole (element 458461, cell 288) leaves for the forest.

The Bambusería de Kodámade: after Kodámade the winners are in her clearing (208670722), where «Más leña al fuego» has them hear her (Dofus pour les noobs («Sous le bois de sa colère»): «Une fois le combat terminé, parlez à Damadrya pour « En savoir plus sur elle »») and leave «pour partir à la poursuite de Kykori»; «Salir de la Bambusería.» (53778), «… para ir en busca de Kykori.» (53779) and «Darle las gracias y salir de la Bambusería.» (53787) leave. INFERRED cell.

The post-boss room of the Tertre du long sommeil (dungeon 139): quest 2451 «Arrête-la si tu peux» has an objective, 18576, that names this map (220729859) after the boss (Hell Mina, 107): «Une fois le donjon terminé, parlez à Hell Mina» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Arrête-la si tu peux»); her last reply there (68025, «Te pido disculpas...») takes the winners out. INFERRED landing cell.

The Fábrica de Malefíscof (dungeon 77): after the machine room (130286592) the winners are in «Brutatax's Factory - Exit» (130287616), where «El maleficio del cofre» (1506) has them talk to Malefíscof: «Une fois le donjon terminé, parlez à Malléfisk avant de sortir» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Malladie»); objectives 8496-8498 name this map. Inès Karcel lets them out: «Parlez de nouveau à Inès Karcel pour sortir» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Fabrique de Malléfisk»), her «Salir.» (21430). The map panel offers no way out here: the client shows it only on a map of the dungeon's own (DungeonsDataRoot.GetDungeonByMapId, MapInfoUI.UpdateContextualOptions), and this room is none. INFERRED landing cell, on the emblem in front of Malefíscof.

King Nidas's palace (dungeon 76) has a single room, and its winners stay in it: «Une fois le donjon terminé, ne sortez pas tout de suite, et parlez au Coffret précieux pour l'attaquer» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Casse en Enutrosor», quest 1908). The room is the dungeon's own map, so the map panel's «Salir de la mazmorra» is the way out. The room being the boss room, the winners keep the cell they fought from (FightHandler: no move when the room is the one they are in).
The Cámara de los Maleficios: after the boss the winners are in the «Salida» room, where NPC 6946 offers to leave; the reply leaves the dungeon through its way out, the entrance map.

The Bastión de los Martilloseco: after the boss the winners are in the «Salida» room, where Demena Decobre (6847) offers «Abandonar el bastión.»; the reply leaves the dungeon through its way out, the entrance map.

Koolich Cavern: after Koolich the winners are in «Koolich Cavern - Exit» (107228160), where Koolich, beaten, lets them go: «Take the hat and leave.», «Take the boots and leave.», «Take the staff and leave.», «Take the bag and leave.», «Take a rain check and leave.» and «Take the ball of gobkool wool and leave.» all leave through the dungeon's way out. Seen in the client: «Take the boots and leave.» gave nothing and the boss win skipped the room. INFERRED cell.

The Jellith Dimension: after the Fourth Room the winners are in the Fifth Room, where the four royals stand and send them on to the room their puddles open (Dofus pour les noobs, «Gelaxième Dimension»: «parlez à n'importe laquelle d'entre elles pour accéder à la salle du boss»; the royals' dialogues, content/npcs/dialogues.json); the map panel leaves. INFERRED cell, open floor below the royals (287, 289, 343, 345).

After the Royal Blue Jelly, the Jellith Dimension's Exit room (98568705), whose magic door leads out: the royals' own «If bou bant to beave our bimension, use the bagic boor» (1590). The door is still a reserved interactive, so the map panel leaves for now. INFERRED cell, open floor beside the door (268).

After the Royal Mint Jelly, the Jellith Dimension's Exit room (98568705), whose magic door leads out: the royals' own «If bou bant to beave our bimension, use the bagic boor» (1590). The door is still a reserved interactive, so the map panel leaves for now. INFERRED cell, open floor beside the door (268).

After the Royal Strawberry Jelly, the Jellith Dimension's Exit room (98568705), whose magic door leads out: the royals' own «If bou bant to beave our bimension, use the bagic boor» (1590). The door is still a reserved interactive, so the map panel leaves for now. INFERRED cell, open floor beside the door (268).

After the Royal Lemon Jelly, the Jellith Dimension's Exit room (98568705), whose magic door leads out: the royals' own «If bou bant to beave our bimension, use the bagic boor» (1590). The door is still a reserved interactive, so the map panel leaves for now. INFERRED cell, open floor beside the door (268).

After the Royal Jellies, the Jellith Dimension's Exit room (98568705), whose magic door leads out: the royals' own «If bou bant to beave our bimension, use the bagic boor» (1590). The door is still a reserved interactive, so the map panel leaves for now. INFERRED cell, open floor beside the door (268).

The Skeleton Dungeon: the winners stay in the Fifth Room, the boss room, where Chaferfu (6459) teaches «Invocation de Chaferfu»: «parler avec le Chaferfu présent dans la salle et de suivre ses instructions pour apprendre le sort» (JeuxOnline, «Donjon des Squelettes»). The win went straight to the exit (82314753) and he was never met. «Aceptar para salir de aquí.» (65567) leaves. INFERRED cell: open floor next to him (413).

The Casa de los Espíritus: after the boss the winners stand in the last room with Kumijo, who does not mind having lost and talks (Dofus pour les noobs, «Une fois le donjon terminé, parlez à Koumiho»); «Salir de la Casa de los Espíritus.» (55519) leaves. INFERRED cell: open floor in the middle of the room.

Cocabulia's lair: after the boss the winners are in the fifth room's second map (198972418) where Cocabulia (4655) lies; Retroceder y asegurarte de que la sed de la espada ha sido saciada antes de abandonar el lugar (39544) leaves. Moja la espada con la sangre de Cocabulia (2036) is her other reply (39545). Dofus pour les noobs (Le forgeur de légende): ne sortez pas tout de suite du donjon... Parlez a la Crocabulia.

Captain Meno's Ship (dungeon 97): after the boss the winners are in «Capitán Meno - Salida» (169874432), where Captain Meno stands beside the ship's wheel (DPLN «Piège de crystal»: «Une fois le donjon terminé, parlez au Capitaine Meno avant de sortir», screenshot titled «Capitaine Meno - Sortie»; the client's own data puts quest 1735's objective 11037 and 1736's hand-over 11042 on this map). His «Leave the submarine» (28923), «Leave Captain Meno's Ship» (28559) and «Shrug your shoulders and leave the submarine» (28933) leave. Cell 425: where the character stands in that screenshot, measured against tools/dibujar_mapa.py; +-1 cell. 35185, 35191 and 35195 («Tomar nota de ello [...] y abandonar el submarino», «Darle las gracias y abandonar el submarino») leave after the 1912 talks.

Dientinea's Palace (dungeon 99): after Dientinea the winners are in her throne room (169612288, screenshot titled «Palais de Dantinéa - Sortie»), where she dictates her demands (1737, objective 11045). «Note down her demands and leave the palace.» (28635) and «Leave the palace.» (28639) leave. Cell 491: where the character stands in the DPLN «Reine de beauté» screenshot of that room, measured against tools/dibujar_mapa.py; +-1 cell.

Nileza's Laboratory (dungeon 70): after Nileza the winners are in «Laboratorio de Nileza - Salida» (109577731, the map's own name), where Nileza stands (DPLN «Une voix de crystal»: «Une fois dans la salle de sortie, parlez à Nileza»). His «Salir del laboratorio» (17538, 17329, 17769) and «Abandonar el laboratorio para ir a Sufokia» (35171, 35173, 35180, 35182) leave. Cell 270: the arrival cell the map gives.

Mansion of Kuatropatas (dungeon 106): after Anerice the winners are in the exit room (182719488, the map's own name 'Mansion de Kuatropatas - Salida'), where Anerice stands (Dofus pour les noobs, Le mort dans l'ame: 'Une fois dans la salle de sortie, parlez a Anerice la Shushess'). Her 'Abandonar la Mansion de Kuatropatas' (33178, 33503, 33542) and 'Hacer una reverencia y despedirte' (33495) leave. Cell 282: the arrival cell the map gives.
Sylargh's Transporter (dungeon 67): after Sylargh the winners are in the exit room (110102530) where Sylargh stands (1915, 13178). His 17332/17485 leaves. Cell 358 INFERRED.

Solar tower: Dofus pour les noobs («Les coeurs livides») «monter les escaliers puis cliquer sur le cœur livide» before leaving; the quest names the room above the boss (187957516, «discover» 13729) where the livid heart is (13730). The win leads there, the god's room (187957518) is up the stairs, and the map panel's «Salir de la mazmorra» leaves from it. INFERRED: that the real game leaves the winners in the boss room with stairs; cell INFERRED.

Bethel tower: Dofus pour les noobs («Les coeurs livides») the same: room above the boss (187439104, 13734) with the livid heart (13735), Raval's room (187440128) up the stairs. INFERRED as in the Solar tower.

Taller de Tanukui San (dungeon 126): after the boss (6218, room 208932864) the winners are in 208932866 where Tanukui San stands (spawns.json). His 'Salir del Taller de Tanukui San' (2578) leaves through the dungeon's own way out. INFERRED cell 300: a walkable cell of the map; Dofus pour les noobs («Au nom de l'Art») only says to talk to him after the last fight.
